descriptions.w3d_worm_attach_alternate_80139858: Attaches an alternate component mesh and applies the stored weapon resource value.
descriptions.w3d_worm_attach_component_mesh_80139900: Obtains a component mesh through its accessor, attaches it and applies the stored weapon resource value.
descriptions.w3d_worm_update_movement_80139f1c: Updates the movement transform and selects directional and secondary animation controls.
descriptions.w3d_worm_update_blend_8013a0d4: Updates the named animation blend from the component while the primary control is playing.
descriptions.w3d_angle_delta_8013aa10: Returns the angular difference, adjusting values beyond either wrap threshold.
